<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אייר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918633_theRebbe_459" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_99_D7_99_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918633_theRebbe_459__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the superiority of the self-nullification of this day over that of the desert lies in two aspects, particularly that it extends into the reality of the person, completing the purpose of a dwelling place in the lower realms.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">And 4)</t>
    <t s="2">And likewise is it regarding the two matters of Rosh Chodesh Sivan,</t>
    <t s="3">the self-nullification of this day and the self-nullification of the desert57,</t>
    <t s="4">that the superiority of the self-nullification of this day over the self-nullification of the desert is in two matters.</t>
    <t s="5">That the self-nullification of this day</t>
    <t s="6">(where the love is in a state of self-nullification)</t>
    <t s="7">is also within the reality of the person.</t>
    <t s="8">And that specifically through this the intention of a dwelling place in the lower realms is completed.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="16">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section states that the self-nullification of this day extending into the person's reality comes through the drawing down of Atzmus (Awtsmoos), which has the power to unite two opposites.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And one may add,</t>
    <t s="1">that this—that the self-nullification of this day is drawn also into the reality of the person</t>
    <t s="2">[and even after the self-nullification that is drawn into his reality, it is</t>
    <t s="3">(not a nullification of existence,</t>
    <t s="4">but rather)</t>
    <t s="5">a nullification within existence],</t>
    <t s="6">is through the drawing down of Atzmus (Awtsmoos),</t>
    <t s="7">for in the power of Atzmus (Awtsmoos) is to unite two opposites</t>
    <t s="8">(self-nullification and existence).</t>
  </section>
  <section v="17">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the term "this day" alludes to the revelation of the power of Atzmus (Awtsmoos), as the true meaning of "this" applies only to Atzmus (Awtsmoos) itself.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it can be said that this is also hinted at in the language of the verse "on this day."</t>
    <t s="1">For it is explained in Likkutei Torah58,</t>
    <t s="2">that the term "this,"</t>
    <t s="3">which is a thing that one can point to with a finger and say "this,"</t>
    <t s="4">applies only to the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="5">as it is written59</t>
    <t s="6">"This is my G-d and I will glorify Him,"</t>
    <t s="7">for "the whole earth is full of His glory"60.</t>
    <t s="8">And it is explained elsewhere61</t>
    <t s="9">that the true concept of "this" applies only to Atzmus (Awtsmoos).</t>
    <t s="10">For the meaning of "this" is that the thing about which one says "this"</t>
    <t s="11">is the very existence of that thing,</t>
    <t s="12">and since all existing things,</t>
    <t s="13">including even the most sublime revelations,</t>
    <t s="14">their existence is not from themselves but is dependent upon the will of Atzmus (Awtsmoos)62,</t>
    <t s="15">one cannot say of them in a complete sense "this thing,"</t>
    <t s="16">and the true concept of "this" applies only to Atzmus (Awtsmoos).</t>
    <t s="17">And this is "on this day,"</t>
    <t s="18">that even the existence of the diffusion</t>
    <t s="19">(day)</t>
    <t s="20">is in a state of self-nullification</t>
    <t s="21">(this),</t>
    <t s="22">is through the revelation of the power of Atzmus (Awtsmoos),</t>
    <t s="23">day</t>
    <t s="24">(revelation)</t>
    <t s="25">this.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
